$$

$$
10 \text{ years} \times 8 \text{ trees/year} = 80 \text{ trees}

$$
50 + 80 = 130 \text{ trees}
$$

---

### **Step 3: 30% of the trees die**

30% of the 130 trees die:

$$
0.30 \times 130 = 39 \text{ trees die}
$$

---

### **Step 4: Trees remaining**

$$
130 - 39 = 91 \text{ trees}
$$

---

### ✅ **Final Answer:**
$$
\boxed{91}
$$
